name: Rococo

influenced_by: a reaction against Louis XIV's formal grandeur

reacts_against: the heavy, dark, symmetrical formality of Louis XIV's Baroque court style, favoring asymmetry, pastel color and lighter subject matter (flirtation, gardens) instead.
revivals: a recurring fashion and interior-design reference (most recently Sofia Coppola's Marie Antoinette, 2006)

wiki_facts.other_names: Late Baroque, Style Louis XV, Style Régence, Pompadour Style
wiki_facts.key_motifs: Shells (rocaille), C-scrolls and S-scrolls, acanthus leaves, putti (cherubs), pastoral scenes, elaborate asymmetry, mythological love stories
wiki_facts.key_colours: Pastel palettes (light pink, powder blue, mint green, cream, lavender), ivory white, gold leaf
wiki_facts.key_values: Frivolity, pleasure, intimacy, elegance, leisure, ornamentation, light-heartedness

findings: mostly muted — about 59% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
